notes.title: Final Tape is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Final Update of The Backrooms Origins[/h2]

With Version 1.2, six new playable levels and VHS indicators are added to the game!

This update is final content update for The Backrooms Origins. From this time, I will focus on my new game, Backrooms Security Room. You can check the Steam page and add to your wishlist from this link:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3101910/Backrooms_Security_Room


[h2]6 New Levels[/h2]

Tape 3 comes with 6 new unique playable backrooms levels. Now you can explore more levels of the backrooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205750/cafa0a536d066ac955eaecd8c5ebf08a3cc90286.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205750/0bbb7d6cc4358f2fd0c8e2320ce8310a5b875328.png[/img]


[h2]Tape Levels Can Playable Separately Now[/h2]

With this version, all levels can be played separately from the tapes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205750/e56e3db974360c19bf65a54434a0b25da7e24605.png[/img]


[h2]VHS Hud[/h2]

As a result of your feedbacks, we added VHS tape indicators to suit the theme of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205750/069b66b7e7e33a17359a9574e42856afcafe8688.png[/img]

notes.title: Tape 2 Now Can Playable!
notes.content: Finally we are releasing Tape 2! You can play 3 new unique levels now.
